    • placeTotem

      public void placeTotem(Game game, String nickname, int offerPosition) throws Exception
      Places the turn player's totem on a free offering tile. Validates turn, double placement and tile availability; then frees the player's slot in the turn order. When all have placed, transitions to PickingState, otherwise passes to the next player.
      Overrides:
      placeTotem in class GameState
      Parameters:
      game - the current game
      nickname - the player placing the totem
      offerPosition - the index of the chosen offering tile
      Throws:
      Exception - if it's not their turn, they have already placed, or the tile is occupied/invalid

    • skipTurn

      public void skipTurn(Game game, String nickname) throws Exception
      Skips the current player's turn (e.g. disconnected): moves them to the bottom of the turn order, marks them as "has placed" and passes to the next.
      Overrides:
      skipTurn in class GameState
      Parameters:
      game - the current game
      nickname - the player to skip
      Throws:
      Exception - if it's not their turn or they have already placed the totem

    • recoverActivePlayer

      public Player recoverActivePlayer(Game game)

    • handleDisconnection

      public void handleDisconnection(Game game, Player p, boolean isCurrentPlayer) throws Exception
      Handles the disconnection of a player during the placement phase: frees the offering tile if they had occupied it, removes them from the turn order compacting the others, and if it was their turn passes to the next. If the exit completes the phase, transitions to PickingState.
      Overrides:
      handleDisconnection in class GameState
      Parameters:
      game - the current game
      p - the disconnected player
      isCurrentPlayer - true if they were the turn player
      Throws:
      Exception - in case of an error in the transition
